records.title: 10-Q
records.text: During the three months ended September 30, 2021, sales to our distributors represented approximately 12% of our total sales, compared to 2% in the same period of 2020 and during the nine months ended September 30, 2021, sales to our distributors represented approximately 8% of our total net sales, compared to 2% in the same period of 2020.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: During the third quarter of 2021, we continued to see strong demand from our customers across the geographic regions and end markets that we serve, with the value of total orders increasing by approximately 30% compared to the same period in 2020.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: ◦The current portion of deferred revenue decreased by $11 million, which was primarily related to the timing of annual software maintenance renewals for our enterprise-level licensing arrangements;

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Additionally, we implemented price increases for certain offerings which increased net sales by approximately 5 percent compared to the same periods in 2020.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For the three months ended September 30, 2021 and 2020, operating income was $34 million and $(2) million, respectively.
